name: Better Markdown Preview with Pele
description: Read and edit Markdown in one live preview: colored headings, organized lists, clean tables, highlighted code, callouts, front matter and Mermaid-syntax diagrams rendered locally with Pele. To open it, open a .md file and click the first icon (the pen nib) in the editor's view toggle.

cover.alt: The plugin name, a hint to click the first icon in the view toggle, and a preview with a colored heading, bullets and a tip callout

screenshots.alt: A table with a compact header and a TypeScript code block with syntax colors and a copy button
screenshots.caption: Tables, code and callouts
